# War Scroll Column 14 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in War Scroll Column 14 where the three translators diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

## 14:1 — "Blessed be" vs. "Praise" — benediction formula

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "Blessed be the-God of-Israel" | Literal barukh formula |
| LOGOS | "Blessed be the God of Israel" | Standard liturgical rendering |
| PNEUMA | "Praise the God of Israel" | Dynamic imperative rendering |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "Blessed be" (EMET/LOGOS). barukh is declarative, not imperative; same ruling as column 12.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 14:1 — "congregation of deceit" vs. "assembly of liars" — anti-community designation

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "congregation of-deceit" | Literal rendering of 'adat remiyyah |
| LOGOS | "congregation of deceit" | Standard DSS scholarly rendering |
| PNEUMA | "assembly of liars" | Dynamic rendering personalizing the abstract |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "congregation of deceit" (EMET/LOGOS). This is a technical sectarian designation; "assembly of liars" personalizes what is an abstract characterization.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 14:3 — "fury of the worthless" vs. "rage of the wicked" — enemy characterization

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "fury of-the-worthless" | Literal rendering; beliya'al related |
| LOGOS | "fury of the worthless" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "rage of the wicked" | Interprets "worthless" as "wicked" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "fury of the worthless" (EMET/LOGOS). The Hebrew implies moral emptiness (worthlessness), not merely wickedness.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 14:4 — "terrible" vs. "awe-inspiring" — divine epithet (recurring)

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "terri[ble]" | Literal with lacuna preserved |
| LOGOS | "terri[ble]" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "awe-inspiring" | Modern rendering, no lacuna marker |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "terri[ble]" (EMET/LOGOS). Same ruling as column 11; the lacuna is genuine and must be marked.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 14:6 — "teachers of battle" vs. "instructors of war" vs. "battle instructors"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "teachers of-battle" | Literal rendering of morey milchamah |
| LOGOS | "instructors of war" | Formal variant |
| PNEUMA | "battle instructors" | Reversed word order |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "instructors of battle" (compromise). "Instructors" is clearer than "teachers" in military context; "battle" retained from EMET.

**Status:** Resolved with compromise.

---

## 14:6 — "standards" vs. "banners" — military terminology

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "standards" | Military terminology for nes/degel |
| LOGOS | "banners" | Alternative military term |
| PNEUMA | "banners" | Same as LOGOS |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "banners" (LOGOS/PNEUMA). More accessible while still conveying the military sense.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS/PNEUMA.

---

## 14:7 — "slaying" vs. "slaughter" vs. "defeat" — intensity of violence

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "slaying" | Literal rendering of makkah |
| LOGOS | "slaughter" | Stronger formal rendering |
| PNEUMA | "defeat" | Euphemistic modern rendering |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "slaughter" (LOGOS). makkah in military context implies massive killing; "defeat" (PNEUMA) is too mild; "slaughter" is appropriately vivid.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 14:9 — "covenant-faithfulness" vs. "faithful love" — hesed (recurring)

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "covenant-faithfulness" | Project convention |
| LOGOS | "covenant-faithfulness" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "faithful love" | Dynamic rendering |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "covenant-faithfulness" (EMET/LOGOS). Project convention; consistency required.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 14:13 — "remnant of Your people" vs. "survivors of Your people" — lacuna rendering

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "rem[nant of-Your-people]" | Preserves lacuna in "remnant" |
| LOGOS | "rem[nant of Your people]" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "sur[vivors of Your people]" | Different word choice for she'erit |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "rem[nant of Your people]" (EMET/LOGOS). she'erit is standardly "remnant" in biblical translation; the lacuna location is correctly placed.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 14:14 — "God of mercies" vs. "God of compassion" — divine epithet

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "God of-mercies" | Literal rendering of 'El ha-rachamim |
| LOGOS | "God of mercies" | Standard rendering |
| PNEUMA | "God of compassion" | Modern English equivalent |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "God of mercies" (EMET/LOGOS). rachamim is the plural "mercies"; "compassion" (singular abstract) loses the plural concreteness.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 14:15 — "dominion of Belial" vs. "Belial's tyranny" — evil power structure

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "dominion of-Belial" | Literal construct chain |
| LOGOS | "dominion of Belial" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "Belial's tyranny" | Possessive with interpretive noun |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "dominion of Belial" (EMET/LOGOS). memshelet is "dominion/rule," not "tyranny"; PNEUMA adds negative connotation not explicit in the term itself.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 14:15 — "mysteries of his enmity" vs. "secret weapons of his hatred"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "mysteries of-his-enmity" | Literal rendering of razey mastmato |
| LOGOS | "mysteries of his enmity" | Standard rendering |
| PNEUMA | "secret weapons of his hatred" | Dynamic military metaphor |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "mysteries of his enmity" (EMET/LOGOS). razey means "mysteries/secrets," not "weapons"; PNEUMA's militarization is unwarranted.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 14:17 — "haughty of stature" vs. "tall of stature" vs. "stood tall in pride"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "haughty-of-stature" | Interprets ramey qomah as pride-related |
| LOGOS | "tall of stature" | Literal physical description |
| PNEUMA | "stood tall in pride" | Dynamic rendering combining both |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "tall of stature" (LOGOS). ramey qomah literally means "high of stature"; the pride interpretation (EMET/PNEUMA) is secondary. The contrast is physical: God raises the fallen and brings down the tall.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

**Total disagreements:** 13
